More than dream beaches: we are the historic cradle of the New World, home to the highest peaks of the island Caribbean, cloud forests, endless mangroves and a land where centuries of history, wild nature and heartfelt hospitality come together.

From the Colonial City of 1502, the first in the Americas, to the untouched expanse of Bahía de las Águilas, the Dominican Republic offers an unmatched geographic and cultural contrast. Every province keeps centuries-old traditions, merengue and bachata in the air, and the warmth of people who welcome visitors like family.

Here, adventure is everywhere: humpback whale watching in the warm waters of Samaná, the scent of coffee plantations in the mountains of Jarabacoa, hiking to the summit of Pico Duarte at more than 3,000 metres, and the most vibrant, best-protected coral reefs in the archipelago.

Each trip has its own e-Ticket and its own QR. Many travelers only fill in the arrival one and have to rush the departure one at the airport. On the new portal, the departure one is created in a moment from the arrival one.
Before the day of your flight you can correct it from your account or with the application code you get when you start. If it's already travel day, the fastest option is to fill in a new one.
You can include your companions, babies and children too, in the same application. Only people over 18 sign the customs declaration.
It doesn't replace the Tourist Card
The Tourist Card (US$10) is separate, although on most commercial flights it's already included in the ticket price.

Ideally between 72 and 24 hours before the flight, and always before check-in. That way you avoid surprises if the connection fails or the portal is overloaded.
No. It's completely free. If a website asks you to pay, it isn't the official site.
Do I fill in one per person?
Every traveler, including babies and children, must be registered, but you don't need one application per person: you can add your companions to the same form.
Is the same one valid for arrival and departure?
No. You need one to arrive and another to leave, each with its own QR. On the new portal, the departure one is created from the arrival one.
Do I need to print it?
It's not mandatory: you can show the QR code on your phone. A printed copy or a screenshot is a backup if your battery or connection runs out.
What if I arrive without an e-Ticket?
You'll have to complete it at the airport before immigration, which can delay you. Do it ahead of time from home.
Why is there no health form anymore?
The new portal removed the health declaration to simplify the process. Now you fill in the immigration details and the customs declaration.

It's a single form that gathers the information required by the Immigration Office and the Customs Office. Every passenger, Dominican or foreign, must complete it to enter or leave the country.
It replaced the old paper forms: in effect since April 2021 and mandatory since September 2021. It's based on laws 285-04, 115-17, 72-02 and 226-06.
